tagline: K. Rivers brings the new album home.
blurb: West Coast rapper K. Rivers celebrates a new album with a release show at The Wiltern in Koreatown on Friday, November 20. For people who love Kendrick Lamar, SZA and ScHoolboy Q, this is a night of hip-hop and R&B live.

podcasts.name: Bodega Boys
podcasts.script: Quick one before we keep going. West Coast rapper K. Rivers has a new album, and he's celebrating it with a release show at The Wiltern in Koreatown, Los Angeles, on Friday, November 20. If Kendrick Lamar, SZA and ScHoolboy Q are in your rotation, this is your kind of night: hip-hop and R&B, live, celebrating a brand-new record. In LA or close by? Get tickets at {link}. That's K. Rivers, The Wiltern, Friday, November 20.

podcasts.name: The Brilliant Idiots
podcasts.script: Alright, LA, listen up. K. Rivers, a West Coast rapper, is celebrating his new album with a release show at The Wiltern in Koreatown on Friday, November 20. If you love Kendrick Lamar, SZA or ScHoolboy Q, you'll want to be in the room for this one: West Coast hip-hop and R&B, live, on album night. Tickets are at {link}. Again, K. Rivers at The Wiltern, Friday, November 20. Go.
